intent: The same 9 s blackout, with the same late frames after it, at 360 packets/s: 3240 sequence numbers, past the jitter buffer's 3000. The buffer takes delta 360 for a new stream and releases it with no loss counted. The writer requests a key frame on its picture ID gap, drops deltas 360-377 and resumes at key frame 378, whose PTS must keep the 9.6 s gap. RED: a writer that re-bases its timestamp at a sequence jump of 3000 or more plays key frame 378 600 ms after frame 89 (timeline). seq2160 passes that mutation, so the pair tells the two paths apart. RED: a writer that takes the arrival gap for the step after a sequence jump of 3000 or more plays key frame 378 and every later frame 300 ms late. The timeline and media span checks fail.
